environment.COMMENT_POLICY: CMake 4 removed compatibility with cmake_minimum_required(VERSION <3.5), which some vcpkg ports still declare. This is the documented escape hatch and applies only to those ports — our own CMakeLists requires 3.25 and is unaffected. Remove once the dependency graph is clean (D-0013).

configurePresets.name: native-debug
configurePresets.description: Sanitizers on. Use for all development and tests. NEVER use for experiments — the ~2x slowdown corrupts every timing measurement (CONVENTIONS.md §8). Fuzzing is NOT here: Apple Clang ships no libFuzzer runtime, so it lives in the native-fuzz preset (D-0015).

configurePresets.name: native-fuzz
configurePresets.description: Apple Clang has no libFuzzer runtime, so this preset uses Homebrew LLVM. P2PGPU_FUZZ_ONLY builds just p2pgpu-protocol + the harnesses, keeping the link surface to header-only flatbuffers so the two compilers never share a libc++ ABI boundary (D-0015).

cacheVariables.COMMENT_AR: Pin the archiver to Apple's. Left alone, CMake pairs /usr/bin/ar with Homebrew's llvm-ranlib, which rewrites the archive into GNU format (members '/', '//', '/0') that Apple's ld rejects: "archive member '/' not a mach-o file". Only bites this preset, because only this one uses a non-Apple toolchain.

configurePresets.name: native-tsan
configurePresets.description: Coordinator concurrency checks. TSan is incompatible with ASan — separate preset by necessity.

configurePresets.name: native-release
configurePresets.description: Optimized, hardening flags on, no sanitizers. Every chart in EVALUATION.md must be produced with this preset, and the CSV header must say so.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Needs EMSDK set. Builds p2pgpu-worker-core + worker-browser only. Emscripten is chainloaded THROUGH vcpkg's toolchain — setting both as CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE would have them silently fight over the same variable.
